# Repository Instructions

## Mermaid Diagrams

Before creating, editing, or reviewing Mermaid diagrams, read and follow the global skill at `~/.agents/skills/mermaid-visual-style/SKILL.md`, resolving `~` to the current user's home directory. Apply its guidance on diagram selection, semantic shapes and labels, emoji cues, pastel role colors and contrast, renderer compatibility, and review. Preserve project-specific meaning and validate Mermaid syntax in the target Markdown renderer when practical.
